hook: 15 million web servers on one VM with smoltcp, DPDK
hookText: 15 million web servers on one VM with smoltcp, DPDK

beats.say: A tongue-in-cheek but technical walkthrough of running over 15 million tiny web servers on one 1-core.
Starting from a 10-line C server, the author hits limits one by one: ephemeral port ranges, kernel socket memory and the cost of syscalls.
The kernel stack ran out of RAM at about 2.5 million servers; with smoltcp an idle server costs about 620 bytes and the run reached 16 million.
